title: Who can apply (ukri.org)
text:
This funding opportunity is open to organisations with standard eligibility. Check if your organisation is eligible .
Who is eligible to apply
This opportunity is open to applicants who meet the individual eligibility criteria .
We welcome applicants from all career stages and from across UK Research and Innovation (UKRI)’s research and innovation communities.
Participants to the sandpit and any subsequent funding will be subject to relevant security or due diligence checks.
Who is not eligible to apply
The following organisations are not eligible to submit an expression of interest:
UK organisations that do not have standard eligibility for UKRI funding, including UK registered businesses, government departments and third sector organisations
international organisations
Collaborators from UK and international organisations that are not eligible to apply can contribute as project partners through cash or in-kind support. Participants to the sandpit will be encouraged to engage with potential collaborators who are not in attendance.
Resubmissions
We will not accept uninvited resubmissions of projects that have been submitted to UKRI. Find out more about UKRI’s resubmission policy .
Equality, diversity and inclusion
We are committed to achieving equality of opportunity for all funding applicants. We encourage applications from a diverse range of researchers.
We support people to work in a way that suits their personal circumstances. This includes:
career breaks
support for people with caring responsibilities
flexible working
alternative working patterns
UKRI can offer disability and accessibility support for UKRI applicants and grant holders during the application and assessment process.
